prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one transparent sprite atlas for a painterly fantasy overhead RPG. Create exactly SIX isolated substantial environment props in a strict THREE COLUMN by TWO ROW grid, landscape aspect 3:2. Each prop must fit entirely within its own equal cell, with generous 12 percent transparent margins on ALL four sides. Never touch or overlap neighboring cells. True transparent RGBA background, absolutely no background scene, labels, text, lettering, UI icons, arrows, grid lines or checkerboard. Camera: fixed NORTH-UP overhead oblique game view, looking down about 50 degrees; see the tops of steps and headstones, not a frontal eye-level view. All objects point straight north, no rotated diamond isometric bases. High-quality original hand-painted fantasy game art with readable silhouettes, matching weathered gray limestone, bluish shadows, muted moss and warm pale worn edges. Upper-left soft daylight. TOP ROW left to right: (1) broad ancient stone staircase ASCENDING from a low open approach at bottom toward a small elevated landing at the back/top; eight uneven broad worn treads, chunky crumbling side parapets, a modest broken arch over the rear landing, moss in joints, chipped stone corners; keep the central stair path unobstructed. (2) distinct DESCENDING stairwell: a rectangular recessed opening in a stone floor, viewed clearly from above; wide worn stairs enter at the bottom/front rim and descend away toward dark blue depth at top/back, low broken masonry edging on left and right, NO tall arch, no magic portal, no light beam; readable steps and a clear walk-in mouth. (3) low ancient burial chest: long rectangular raised limestone grave with a heavy cracked lid, worn botanical carving and small moss tufts, angled top clearly visible; no skulls, no body. BOTTOM ROW left to right: (4) old arched headstone with carved recessed face, subtle worn circular sun emblem, low double plinth, small irregular stone grave slab extending in front; (5) taller narrow gabled memorial stone, broken upper corner, weathered illegible engraving grooves, climbing ivy on one side, small rough stone base; (6) short broken obelisk grave marker leaning slightly on a square stepped base, a few fallen stone chips and lichen, no magical glow. These are real scenery objects, not inventory icons. Light moss and a few grass tufts only at the bases; small contact shadows, no large opaque ground platforms. No creatures, no people, no modern grave plaques. Leave clear empty gutters between all six props.
